_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 13: June 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says some people are badly planted, repeats his call to pray over Jerome Powell, and says he saw Powell being influenced by people in Europe and by Democrats.
mentions.quote: I saw him being influenced by people in Europe and by people in the
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of external political influence on Fed decision making.

mentions.claim_text: He says an even greater acceleration comes this fall around 21 September when Rosh Hashanah starts, likened to labour pains, and that they are running out of time.
mentions.quote: come this fall around September the 21st or whatever it is when Ra start
mentions.falsify_match: A marked acceleration of events from late September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will not bring in the harvest by himself but will use everyone, women, children and youth alike, because the harvest is plentiful and the labourers few.
mentions.quote: It's all hands on deck
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer over the Fourth of July and over New York City, says he sees a van, and asks that the FBI and homeland security be given dreams so they are warned.
mentions.quote: Pray over this van. I see a van
mentions.falsify_match: A vehicle attack in New York around 4 July 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes without one, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says this Sunday will be a day of remembrance and a good day, and notes his birthday on 3 July as June ends.
mentions.quote: This Sunday will be a day of remembrance. It'll be a good day
mentions.falsify_match: Something memorable on 29 June 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a legal decision due by 15 August that then goes to a second court and could run clear into 2026, and says he saw the enemy hovering above the decision making on crypto putting a kink in the hose.
mentions.quote: they have to make another decision by August 15th
mentions.falsify_match: The crypto ruling slipping to a higher court and into 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says he warned about certain cryptos and about car loans and house loans, and that a major decision was taken on that which he then saw reported in an article, from a word given well before.
mentions.quote: I warned you all about a certain cryptos that cryptos and for car loans
mentions.falsify_match: Crypto formally accepted as collateral or reserve for car and home loans.

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether this is Ezekiel 38 and 39 he says plainly that it is not, but that it is the beginning stages, first the blade then the ear then the full manifestation.
mentions.quote: Is this Ezekiel 38 and39? Obviously not
mentions.falsify_match: Worth recording as a restraint: he declines the biggest available reading of a live conflict.

mentions.claim_text: He says that by this time next year in 2026 you will not recognise where things are now, that change comes at a rapid pace, and points at summer 2026 going into the fall of 2026 and on to 2027.
mentions.quote: this time next year in 2026, you won't even recognize where we are
mentions.falsify_match: The world in mid 2026 being unrecognisable relative to mid 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch the fig tree because Israel is the fig tree, prays for the great harvest and last outpouring and for America not to be attacked from within, and passes on an instruction to pray for a period beginning the 14th.
mentions.quote: praying for America not to be attacked within
mentions.falsify_match: An attack inside America from mid month.

mentions.claim_text: He says that back in December the Lord showed him they would call peace and safety and that there would be peace agreements, and that seven months later it is in the news.
mentions.quote: the Lord showed me that they'll call peace and safety
mentions.falsify_match: Peace agreements announced in mid 2025, matching a December 2024 statement locatable in the corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No prior statement, or no agreements.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer over the Fourth of July and over the nation's churches and megachurches, naming Joel Osteen and Steven Furtick, and says he saw judgment begin in the house of the Lord as a two sided thing.
mentions.quote: I saw uh that judgment begin in the house of the Lord
mentions.falsify_match: Judgment falling on named megachurches, whether by scandal or attack.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord keeps bringing up Timothy McVeigh, that he questioned why, and was told not to forget him because it is what he used.
mentions.quote: don't forget Timothy McVey because I'm trying to ta
mentions.falsify_match: A domestic bombing using a fertiliser truck, the Oklahoma City method.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing a Macy's sign with people on the curbs celebrating, thought it might be Thanksgiving, but says there were leaves on the trees so it was not.
mentions.quote: there was leaves on the trees and so there I know it was
mentions.time_phrase: leaves on the trees, not Thanksgiving
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a Macy's parade or store event outside the Thanksgiving season.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a waterway or strait to pray over because there will be disruptions there in the days ahead, across Monday through Thursday of the coming week.
mentions.quote: There's going to be disruptions there
mentions.falsify_match: Disruption to a strait, most plausibly Hormuz, in that week.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will speak to you inside whatever you are into, cars, baking, books or gardening, down to when best to plant a tomato, if you knock and seek.
mentions.quote: he'll talk to you about the tomato, when the best t
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on asking, seeking and knocking
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He reads out where the live audience is watching from, listing Florida, California, Korea, Wichita, San Francisco, Canada, Australia and Hong Kong late on a Sunday evening.
mentions.quote: Florida, California, Korea, Witchah, Kansas, San Francisco, Canada, Australia
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: audience roll call.

mentions.claim_text: He describes squares marked boldly in black on a calendar with Rosh Hashanah highlighted, a big circle drawn around September, and some kind of dust.
mentions.quote: it was circled with a big circle around September
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event in September 2025, with dust as a marker.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they retaliate the man will use whatever he can, dirty bombs or otherwise, and repeats that he saw a Hitler-like spirit come on him.
mentions.quote: dirty bombs or whatever. I told you I saw that spirit coming on that man
mentions.falsify_match: Use of a radiological or dirty bomb following retaliation.

mentions.claim_text: He says a biological attack is coming in the days ahead from the mountains, with mustard gas or something like it, and that if it was eliminated today then prayer changed things.
mentions.quote: biological attack in the days ahead from the mountains
mentions.condition_text: he states in the same breath that prayer may have already removed it
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical or biological attack originating from mountainous terrain.

mentions.claim_text: He says the largest megachurch in America represents something in the spirit realm and that is why the enemy was targeting it, and asks prayer for its pastor and his wife.
mentions.quote: the largest church in America. It represents something
mentions.falsify_match: An attack or attempt on the largest US megachurch.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that faith comes by hearing the word of God and that confession is made unto salvation, so faith has to be stirred up by hearing.
mentions.quote: Faith cometh by hearing and hearing by the word of God
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says September was circled and the Lord said going into the fall there is more, and prays for Judge Torres not to be influenced, calling the wealth of the sinner laid up for the righteous.
mentions.quote: pray for the month of September. It was circled
mentions.falsify_match: A significant ruling from Judge Torres and a notable autumn 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer calling protection over named areas and over Trump, with flags seen again as a representation over the Fourth of July.
mentions.quote: I see these flags again. It's a representation of this over the 4th
mentions.falsify_match: An incident on 4 July 2025 in the US.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer declaring divine increase and acceleration and that they will have the glory of the Lord in 2025, 2026 and 2027.
mentions.quote: We will have the glory of the Lord. 2025, 2025, 2026, 2027
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: word for word repeat of YdurXtq8kSg@3312 three months earlier.

mentions.claim_text: He struggles with the pronunciation of Rosh Hashanah, jokes that Hebrew speakers will correct him, and marks the period from that feast.
mentions.quote: From that t
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: aside.

mentions.claim_text: He points back to a video from early 2025 in which he said something was assured within a twenty four hour period, and says the Lord told him to pay attention to what he said.
mentions.quote: you said in a 24hour period that was assured
mentions.falsify_match: The earlier 24 hour claim can be located and checked against what followed.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior statement is found.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Apollyon come out of the pit spinning like a top for war, and that the Lord said 2025 will be war war, which he heard privately in prayer and hears again.
mentions.quote: The Lord said 2020 2025 will be war war
mentions.falsify_match: 2025 dominated by war.

mentions.claim_text: He says that back in January he was told about the missile Israel would need and saw USA written on the side of it, and gives the glory to God for the specificity.
mentions.quote: I saw USA on the side of this missile
mentions.falsify_match: American munitions supplied to Israel for the June 2025 exchange, and a January statement locatable in the corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No prior statement at that date.

mentions.claim_text: He dates a prophetic word to 20 August 2014 and says that shows how many years of warning God gives, calling him a God of mercy.
mentions.quote: It was August the 20th of 2014
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as framing, and it is the widest lead time claimed anywhere in the corpus: eleven years.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that there be no terrorist attacks on American soil, coming specifically against trains, box trucks and vans full of fertiliser.
mentions.quote: the the the uh the vans full of fertilizer
mentions.falsify_match: A fertiliser bomb or rail attack in the US, which would also confirm the Timothy McVeigh word.
